answer.read: Selvbrunn opened at a price well above today's level, citing index rises in copper, labour and producer prices [S]. Its sales director says head office has frozen price reductions until December 2027, but he is open on payment terms and call-off flexibility [Z M1]. Price moves above two percent need committee approval [Z M2]. It wants the renewal settled before the framework expires and has asked for our volumes [Z P03]. Its on-time delivery has slipped to well below target [D sc:70530], and our should-cost sits below its quote [E].
answer.message: Thank you for your offer. We would like to secure a stable longer-term arrangement with you, and our attached sheet offers a longer contract term with longer payment terms in return for a price closer to the underlying cost of this part. Given the recent delivery performance and our growing requirement, we believe this gives both sides planning security. We look forward to your confirmation.
answer.reason: E0 is the only selectable option, because every other term mix has an unknown supplier trade value. It gives the supplier what it signalled it can move on: payment terms, plus a longer commitment that answers its renewal concern. Our should-cost, its delivery record and our higher forecast support the price ask, which is not far below its quote.
